mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months when YoY GDPC1 growth is accelerating.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances when INDPRO trigger is active.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of instances when UNRATE trigger is active.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year while the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a housing-led economic boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 35% of instances when both HOUST and FEDFUNDS triggers are active.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) of more than 2% over 6 months, combined with a flat or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), signals a tightening of monetary conditions that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL 6-month growth > 2% and FEDFUNDS flat or rising
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 45% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS triggers are active.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and falling, it signals a tightening labor market that will lead to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of instances when UNRATE trigger is active.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year for two consecutive quarters, it signals a consumer-led economic boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth > 5% for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances when RSAFS trigger is active.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) rises by more than 3% year-over-year while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a supply-driven economic expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 35% of instances when both INDPRO and UNRATE triggers are active.
